decisions.reason: The multi-model mobile flail shredder line reflects substantial sunk development and visible public commitment, so management would still tend to continue and explain any weak performance by sales-cycle and market-rollout factors rather than reverse course.

This mobile grinder line has meaningful investment and remains aligned with the firm's mobile recycling-solutions direction, so despite less visible commitment than a dedicated page management would likely persist for now.

As a single stationary electric fine shredder with lower public prominence, it is easier to sacrifice after several years if uptake has disappointed, especially once temporary explanations become less convincing.

The green-waste grinder line is a specialized but still relevant extension of the firm's mobile processing portfolio, and sunk costs plus niche strategic fit make management more inclined to retain it than to withdraw it immediately.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line combines several models with clear public positioning and strong fit to tougher recycling applications, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
